Name: Placeable Mine Shaft
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod simply adds a placeable mine shaft to the game that works similar to the placeable staircase.

The optional config parameters affect what happens when you jump into a mine shaft:

[list]
[*][b]﻿PercentDamage: [/b]affects the amount of damage you take when falling, which is normally [i]﻿levelsDown * 3[/i] (default: [b]100[/b] i.e. no change)
[*][b]MinLevels, MaxLevels:[/b] affect the number of levels you fall, which is normally 3 - 8 but has some quirks (default: [b]3[/b] and [b]9[/b])
[*][b]PreventGoingToSkullCave:[/b] prevents a mine shaft dropped in the mine from taking you to Skull Cavern if you fall beyond level 120 (default: [b]true[/b])
[*][b]SkipConfirmOnShaftJump:[/b] skips the confirmation dialogue when you click on a mine shaft (default: [b]false[/b])
[/list]
You'll need to install SMAPI to run this mod:

[url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url]

Then place this mod in your Mods directory and unzip it.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
